q: Lwaki Susanna Wesley yayita mutabani we "ekisiki ekyaggyibwa mu muliro"?
a: Ekiro kya 9 February 1709 ennyumba ya kabona e Epworth yakwata omuliro, era mu kudduka ebweru ab'omu maka ne bazuula nti John, omwana ow'emyaka etaano, yali alekeddwa nga yeebase waggulu. Baliraanwa ne beefuula amadaala, omusajja omu ng'ayimiridde ku bibegabega bya munne, ne bamuggya mu ddirisa ng'akasolya kaakasigazza akaseera katono okugwa. Nnyina Susanna yatwala okuwonyezebwa okwo ng'okuyitibwa okuva eri Katonda, era ng'akozesa ebigambo bya Zekkaliya 3:2, okuva olwo yayogeranga ku mutabani we ng'ekisiki ekyaggyibwa mu muliro.

Mu Oxford ku nkomerero y'emyaka gya 1720, Wesley yatwala mu mikono gye akabinja akatono muganda we Charles ke yali akuŋŋaanyizza olw'okusaba, okusiiba, Ekyekiro buli wiiki, n'okukyalira abasibe n'abaavu b'omu kibuga. Ettendekero lyaduulira empisa zaabwe ez'essaawa n'amannya ag'okuduula agawerako, era eryawangaala lyali Methodists, olw'okutya Katonda kwabwe okw'entegeka. Akabinja kano, akaayitibwanga era Holy Club, kwe kaali George Whitefield omuvubuka gye yasookera okwegatta ku bo n'akyusibwa.

q: Obuweereza bwa Wesley mu Georgia bwawangula?
a: Bwalemererwa mu buli ngeri abantu gye bapima. Ng'atumiddwa mu 1735 okuweereza abatuuze era ng'asuubira okukyusa abantu ab'omu kitundu, yalabika nga mukakanyavu we yali yeetaagira amagezi ag'okukwatagana n'abantu, era okulabirira kwe okwatabulatabula ng'omusumba ku muwala omuvubuka ayitibwa Sophy Hopkey kwakoma bubi; bwe yafumbirwa omusajja omulala, Wesley n'amugaana Ekyekiro, era ab'omu maka ga bba ne bamuwaabira mu kkooti. Yavaayo mu kitundu mu kyama ku nkomerero ya 1737, ng'asala omusango nti yali agenze mu Amerika okukyusa abalala so nga ye yennyini teyali akyusiddwa.

q: Kiki ekyatuuka ku Wesley mu Aldersgate Street mu 1738?
a: Akawungeezi ka 24 May 1738 yagenda, nga bw'akyogera yennyini ng'atayagala nnyo, mu lukuŋŋaana lw'ekibiina mu Aldersgate Street, waliwo omuntu eyali asoma ennyanjula ya Luther ku Abaruumi. Mu Journal ye yawandiika nti: "Nga bukyali ng'ekitundu ky'essaawa nga tewannawera mwenda ez'ekiro … nnawulira omutima gwange nga gubuguumirira mu ngeri ey'ekitalo. Nnawulira nti nnali nneesiga Kristo, Kristo yekka, olw'obulokozi; era ne mpeebwa obukakafu nti Yeye yali anziggyeeko ebibi byange, weewaawo, ebyange nze kennyini, era n'annokola mu mateeka g'ekibi n'okufa." Kye yafuna ekiro ekyo tekyali njigiriza mpya wabula obukakafu, era Abamethodist bakyajjukira olunaku olwo.

q: Kabona wa Oxford eyali afaayo ennyo ku mpisa yatuuka atya okubuulira mu nnimiro enjereere?
a: Whitefield, eyali atandise dda okubuulira ebweru eri abasima amanda, ye yeegayirira Wesley ajje e Bristol akitandike, era Wesley mu kusooka yawunyiriza, ng'akwatirira nnyo entegeka y'ekkanisa n'okutuusa okulowooza nti okulokola emmeeme kyandibadde kumpi ekibi singa tekikolerwa mu kizimbe. Yagonda nga 2 April 1739, ng'alangirira Enjiri mu bbanga eddungi eri abantu nga enkumi ssatu. Emimbari gy'ekkanisa bwe gyamuggalirwako, yawolereza okutambula kwe n'ekigambo ekyafuuka omulamwa gwa Methodism: "Ensi yonna ngitwala ng'ekitundu kyange eky'obuweereza."

q: Wesley ddala yavuga embalaasi emayiro kumpi obukumi abiri mu butaano?
a: Okumala emyaka egisukka mu ataano, okuva mu 1739 okutuusa lwe yanafuwa n'alemererwa okulinnya embalaasi, yagolokokanga ku ssaawa kkumi ez'oku makya, n'abuulira ku ssaawa kkumi n'emu eri abakozi nga bagenda mu bunnya bw'amanda ne mu makolero, era n'asomera ku ntebe y'embalaasi ng'embalaasi ye ekwata oluguudo. Emiwendo egyatiibwa egy'emayiro nga 250,000 n'okubuulira nga 40,000 gye magezi ga bulijjo abawandiisi b'ebyafaayo ab'oluvannyuma ge baakisa okuva mu ntambula ze, era gyawukana wakati w'ensibuko, kale kisinga okubitwala ng'ekigero eky'obungi so si ng'okubala okukakasibwa. Obukakafu obw'amazima ye Journal gye yakuuma mu myaka egyo gyonna, ejjudde eby'okwewuunya nga tewali kubala.

q: Ekitone kya Wesley eky'okutegeka kyali kitya?
a: Ekitone kye ekyawangaala tekyali kwogera bulungi, kubanga Whitefield yamusinga okubuulira, wabula entegeka: yakuŋŋaanya abaakyuka mu bibiina, oluvannyuma n'agabanya ebibiina mu bubinja obw'abantu nga kkumi na babiri, buli kamu nga kalina omukulembeze eyabasisinkananga buli wiiki n'ababuuza engeri emmeeme zaabwe gye zaali zikulaakulanamu. Yalonda abakozi ab'emikono aba bulijjo ng'ababuulizi abateewongebwa ng'abakabona tebaagala kumuyamba, n'abakuŋŋaanyiza mu Conference eya buli mwaka okuva mu 1744, era mu 1784 n'akakasa ebiseera by'omu maaso eby'ekibiina ng'ayita mu Deed of Declaration. Mu mwaka ogwo gwe gumu ye yennyini yawonga abaweereza olwa Amerika, omutendera ogwafuula okwawukana ne Kkanisa ya England okutasoboka kwewala.

q: Obufumbo bwa Wesley bwali bwa ssanyu?
a: Nedda. Mu February 1751 yawasa Mary Vazeille, nnamwandu omugagga gwe yayitanga Molly, era obufumbo bwayonooneka mangu ne busigala bwe butyo okumala emyaka nga amakumi asatu, nga bunyigirizibwa okutambula kwe okutaggwaawo n'okunyiiga kwe olw'ekyo. Yagenda emirundi egisukka gumu, era ku kugenda kwe okw'enkomerero mu 1771 yawandiika ebigambo bisatu ebikalu eby'Olulattini ebitera okuvvuunulwa nti: "Saamulekulira; saamugoba; sijja kumuyita adde." Omusajja eyasobola okutegeka obulamu obw'omwoyo obw'obukumi n'obukumi bw'abantu teyasobola kutegeka obw'oyo eyali amusembera okusinga bonna, era teyakinnyonnyola ddala.

q: Lwaki Wesley ne Whitefield baawukana, era baddamu okutabagana?
a: Whitefield yali Mukalvini akakafu ate Wesley si bw'atyo; mu 1739 Wesley yabuulira oluvannyuma n'afulumya Free Grace, olutalo olutaliimu kisa ku njigiriza y'okulondebwa edda olwanuubula mukwano gwe era olwayawulamu okuzuukuka mu makubo abiri. Naye okwagala kwawangaala okusinga empaka, era baatuuka ku ekyo omu ku babuulizi ba Wesley kye yayita endagaano ey'okwawukana mu ndowooza. Bwe yabuuzibwa emirundi mingi ani asaanira okubuulira ku kuziikibwa kwe, Whitefield yeeyongera okuyita Wesley, era Whitefield bwe yafa mu 1770, Wesley n'ayimuka n'abuulira okubuulira okwo n'omutima omugabi.

q: Wesley yawandiika ki, era ajjukirwa atya okusingira ddala?
a: Journal ye, gye yakuuma okumala ekitundu ky'ekyasa n'okusingawo, kye kijjukizo kye, awamu ne Sermons on Several Occasions ne A Plain Account of Christian Perfection, ennyonnyola esinga obujjuvu ey'enjigiriza ye esinga okuwakanyizibwa nti okwagala Katonda ne muliraanwa kusobola okukula okutuusa lwe kufuga obulamu. Yafiira okumpi ne City Road Chapel nga 2 March 1791, ng'aweza emyaka kinaana mu musanvu, era ng'anaatera okugenda yeewuunyisa mikwano gye ng'ayimba oluyimba lwa Isaac Watts "Nnaatendereza Omutonzi wange nga nkyalina omukka." Emirundi egisukka gumu yagamba abo abaali ku kitanda ekintu kye yamala obulamu bwe ng'akibuulira abagwira: "Ekisinga byonna obulungi kiri nti, Katonda ali naffe."
